title: Spend import review
notes: Synthetic review scenario grounded in implemented Vendor transaction-import and derived-fact substrate; the proposed reconciliation decision contract is a planned extension.
reviewQuestions: Can a reviewer verify field mappings and preview the changes before saving?
Can a reviewer see uncertain matches, source provenance, and the bounded correction without overwriting source evidence?
outcomes: A user can save an import after checking its mappings and change preview.
The save outcome separates imported transactions from uncertain matches that remain in review.
